calendar.title: Check Instagram Export Email
calendar.details: Check your email for Instagram data export and upload to Unfollow Tracker at safeunfollow.app

entry.title: First, ask Instagram for your file.

timeCost.theirs: Instagram then emails the file — the wait is theirs, not ours.

trust.noLogin: No login. No password. Nothing to connect.
trust.local: Your export is read in this browser and never uploaded.

recipe.title: What to pick in Instagram's dialog

1.title: Choose Your Instagram Profile
1.description: Select your Instagram account from the list of connected profiles.
1.alt: Instagram's export screen showing the list of connected profiles.

2.title: Select "Export to device"
2.description: Choose to export directly to your device for maximum privacy. Your data stays with you.
2.alt: The destination screen with "Export to device" selected.

3.title: Select Only "Followers and following"
3.description: Click "Customize" › Clear all checkboxes › Check ONLY "Followers and following". This keeps your file small and fast.
3.alt: The "Customize" panel with only "Followers and following" checked.

4.title: Set Date Range to "All time"
4.description: Click "Date range" › Select "All time" › Save. This ensures you get your complete follower history.
4.alt: The "Date range" panel with "All time" selected.

5.title: Change Format to JSON
5.description: This is critical! Click "Format" › Select "JSON" (not HTML). HTML files will NOT work with our analyzer.
5.alt: The "Format" panel with "JSON" selected instead of HTML.

6.title: Review & Start Export
6.description: Verify your settings show: Followers and following, All time, JSON format. Then click "Start export".
6.alt: The export summary showing Followers and following, All time and JSON, above the "Start export" button.

7.title: Wait for Email & Download
7.description: Instagram will email you when ready (usually 5-30 minutes). Click the download link in the email to get your ZIP file.
7.alt: Instagram's email with the download link for the ZIP file.
